Gavin Newsom Rules Out 2028 Presidential Run if Kamala Harris Competes

California Governor Gavin Newsom stated he will not run for president in 2028 if Kamala Harris decides to seek the Democratic nomination. Newsom made this declaration in an interview with CNN, a clip of which was shared on Monday. He described his relationship with former President Trump as "darker now." Newsom is widely considered a potential contender for the 2028 presidential election.
